shows.title: Demonic Influence / Betty & Barney Hill Case
shows.first_half: First Half: Author Beatty Carmichael will discuss the spiritual laws of the unseen world and how demonic forces may be behind many of the destructive patterns people repeatedly experience in their lives, including addiction, anxiety, chronic struggles, failed relationships, and anger.
shows.second_half: Second Half: C2C's investigative reporter Cheryll Jones will present her interview with author and UFO researcher Kathleen Marden, an expert on the famed Betty and Barney Hill alien abduction case in 1961. Followed by Open Lines—give George and Cheryll a call to discuss whatever's on your mind!

shows.title: Rock & Roll Twilight Zone / Open Lines
shows.first_half: Joining George Noory, Richard Syrett, a regular guest host on Coast to Coast AM since 2014, discusses his new book, Tales from the Rock & Roll Twilight Zone, exploring the evidence behind the myths and mysteries. He'll share eerie stories surrounding some of music's biggest legends, including cursed songs, mysterious deaths, ghostly encounters, occult connections, and other unexplained phenomena. Followed by Open Lines in the latter half. Give George a call and discuss whatever is on your mind!
